notes: This is the real Editor with a small public example project. The tabs above the canvas switch between six views of the same Slides document. Normal is where you edit. Browse shows thumbnails; Outline shows each title with its Story summary, which is the fastest way to read the argument. Sections manages how the deck is divided. Notes page is a large editor for the speaking script. History shows named versions and saved operations for the selected slide. Switching view never changes the content; it changes what you look at. The next section walks through these views in the order you would use them.

designIntent.purpose: Orient the audience with the whole workspace and its six views.
keep: Full English Normal-view capture, uncropped, original aspect ratio
